source_refs.title: Get LED flash alerts on your iPhone or iPad - Apple Support
source_refs.section: Turn on LED Flash for Alerts; Flash on Silent
source_refs.applicability: iPhone; the page states the LED flash works only when the device is locked
source_refs.verified_excerpt: LED Flash for Alerts works only when your device is locked.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: 1. Open the Settings app, tap Accessibility, then tap Audio/Visual. 2. Turn on LED Flash for Alerts. LED Flash for Alerts works only when your device is locked. To prevent LED flashes when your iPhone is in silent mode, turn off Flash on Silent.
